title: feat(plugin-list,plugin-view,plugin-grid): list chrome on fewer rows — description on the active tab, sort note as an info control, one footer row (objectui#12528)
body:
Part of #12528
Clause-②: yes (widening — `ViewTabItem.description` in `@object-ui/plugin-view` and `ObjectGridComponentProps.onColumnSummaryChange` in `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, both optional host props, never authored metadata)

This PR lands nails 1, 2 and 4 of the family card. **Nail 3 (the dashboard metric card) is not in it**: the card names `MetricCard.tsx` as the site, but the HotCRM Sales Performance KPI tiles are not drawn by `MetricCard` (see "Nail 3" below). The card stays open for that nail, which is why this body says Part of rather than closing it.

## What changed

**Nail 1 — the view description no longer takes a row above the toolbar.**
- `ListView` draws no `view-description` row. The toolbar row sits at one height with or without a description.
- `ViewTabItem` gains an optional `description` (already resolved to the viewer's language and already gated on `appearance.showDescription`). `ViewTabBar` draws it on the ACTIVE tab only: as the view button's `title` tooltip and as a `DropdownMenuLabel` heading its ▾ actions menu (the one place a touch user can read it). The ViewTabBar edit is confined to those two spots.
- The console's `ObjectView` fills it per view with `pickLocalized(view.description, displayLocale)`, the same resolution `ListView` used, gated on the same switch the relay hands `ListView` (`false` shows it nowhere).
- Where no tab strip is drawn, measured: (a) the console below `sm` hands `ListView` no `toolbarLeading` (`useViewTabsFit`), and (b) any other host of `ListView` passes none (`ObjectView` is the only `toolbarLeading` producer on main). There `ListView` draws the description as an info control (`view-description-info`, an `Info` icon whose `title` and accessible name are the description) at the start of its own toolbar row, inside the row's `h-7` height, so it is not lost. (c) A refused view draws the refusal face in place of `ListView`, so no list chrome or description is drawn there; that is unchanged.

**Nail 2 — the sort popover's standing lookup note.**
- The `list.sortRelationalHint` paragraph is gone. Under the paragraph's own condition (a relational field was left out of the list), an info control (`sort-relational-info`) beside the popover title carries the note as its tooltip and accessible name.
- One line (`sort-relational-picked`, new key `list.sortRelationalPicked`, in all ten packs and in `ListView`'s provider-less defaults) appears only while the current sort names a linked column. The picker never offers one, so it can only come from a stored or URL sort, shown as "NAME (by ID)".

**Nail 4 — one footer row on an aggregated list.**
- `ObjectGrid` gains the `onColumnSummaryChange` host prop. When it is passed, the grid draws no summary row and reports, in column order, `{ key, header, label }` for each summary. It reports through a render-null `FooterSummaryReport`, mounted where the row would be, so whatever withholds the row (grouped grid, card view, loading or error face, unmount) reports `null`. The report is keyed on the text, not on array identity (AGENTS.md #10).
- `ListView` passes it to the grid and draws the summaries at the right of its record-count row (`record-count-summaries`, `ml-auto min-w-0 truncate`, full text as `title`). The row draws for either half, so `showRecordCount: false` does not drop the summaries.
- A grid with no host callback keeps its own summary row, unchanged.

## Nail 3 — premise measured false for the named site; not built

The card reads `MetricCard.tsx` as "title + icon, then the description, then a `text-2xl` value, then a unit line". `MetricCard` at the card's commit `720f6d4` and at current main draws title + icon, then the value, then a trend/description line. It has no unit line and no description above the value. The HotCRM Sales Performance tiles (`hotcrm` `src/sales/dashboards/sales.dashboard.ts`, e.g. widget `total_pipeline_value`: `type: 'metric'` with `dataset: 'opportunity_metrics'`) are dataset-bound metrics. They render through `DashboardRenderer`'s shared widget `Card`, whose `CardHeader` holds the title and the `line-clamp-2` description, and through `DatasetWidget`, which draws `MetricWidget`'s `bare` layout (the large colored number, then the measure label, which is the "unit" line in the screenshot). The four-line stack therefore lives in `DashboardRenderer.tsx` and `DatasetWidget.tsx`/`MetricWidget.tsx`, both outside this order's file surface. Changing `MetricCard` would leave the screen the card measured unchanged. Also measured: the spec's dashboard widget declares no `showDescription` key (`@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.1 declares `showDescription` only on the list view's `appearance` and the dashboard `header`). The re-scope question is in the dev report on the card.

## Tests

Pins, one per nail, each with its control:
- `plugin-view` `ViewTabBar.description-12528.test.tsx`: the active tab trigger's `title` is the description, the ▾ menu is headed by it, an inactive tab carries none. CONTROL: a view with no description has no title and no header.
- `app-shell` `ObjectView.refreshInPlace-10035.test.tsx` (new describe): through the page, no `view-description` and no `view-description-info`, and the active tab's tooltip is the view's description. `appearance.showDescription: false` gives no tooltip. The file's remount probe moves from the retired `view-description` node to `list-toolbar-leading`, which `ListView` also owns.
- `plugin-list` `ListView.test.tsx` / `ListView.descriptionInlineLocale-7199.test.tsx`: no row; the info control carries the resolved text; a host strip makes the list draw none.
- `plugin-list` `ListView.relationalSort.test.tsx` (new describe): no paragraph, an info control with the note. A linked column in the current sort shows the one line. CONTROL: a plain-field sort shows no line. Four existing sort tests now read the note off the control's `title`.
- `plugin-grid` `footerSummaryHost-12528.test.tsx`: with the host prop, a report and no `column-summary-footer`, and `null` on unmount. CONTROL: no host prop keeps the grid's own row.
- `plugin-list` `ListView.footerOneRow-12528.test.tsx`: one `record-count-bar` holding "9 records" and the summaries, truncated with a `title`. CONTROL: no summaries leaves the row as it was.

## Acceptance notes

- **Docs not touched (outside the file surface).** `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` (Column Summaries) and the `plugin-view` README's `ViewTabItem` export list do not mention the two new host props. Carrier: none.
- **Browser readings are the landing seat's**, per the card: Accounts and Leads toolbars at one y, the sort popover's height, and the Accounts footer as one row, at 1440 on HotCRM.
- Serial note: open #12537 edits `ViewTabBar.tsx` (the strip's host width). This branch changes only the active tab's `title` and the ▾ menu's header in that file, and it was merged with `origin/main` before opening.
